mechanism: Build a solo performance through a scale-changing camera arc: establish the whole body in a large empty venue, advance to close expressive proof, let the body descend into one floor-level low point, then restore vertical energy in a final isolated light. The reusable template excludes any storyboard or prompt-demo overlay and depends on the visible fall-to-rise performance logic.

invariants.rule: Open with full-body scale inside a visibly larger venue.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening close removes the scale contrast needed later.

invariants.rule: Move closer only after the body's initial movement language is established.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate close coverage turns the piece into a generic portrait.

invariants.rule: Use one controlled descent as the single decisive low point.
invariants.purpose: Gives the performance an irreversible middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated falls become choreography noise rather than structure.

invariants.rule: Hold the low point with a camera relation that proves floor contact and body geometry.
invariants.purpose: Prevents the descent from reading as a cutaway.
invariants.ablation_failure: A hidden landing weakens physical causality.

invariants.rule: End upright in one isolated light, without recreating the opening framing.
invariants.ablation_failure: Returning to the exact opening makes the arc feel reset rather than resolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
